Habanero Vinegar
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, February 12, 2010 - 3:50am

Ingredients




1 cup champagne vinegar
(or white wine vinegar)
1 fresh habanero chili - (1/2 oz) rinsed, stemmed

Preparation

1 In a blender, whirl vinegar and habanero chili until chili is pureed. 2 This recipe yields about 1 cup. 3 Comments: If making ahead, cover and chill vinegar up to 1 month. 4 Yield: 1 cup
